recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交在紅色對比染色背景上，許多腫瘤細胞核內出現深藍黑色的顆粒狀訊號，定位在細胞核；大量 EBER 陽性的漿母細胞樣腫瘤支持 EBV 陽性漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Nuclear blue-black chromogenic signal (EBER) in a large proportion of tumor cell nuclei
Signal is granular to solid and confined to nuclei
Pink nuclear fast red-type counterstain of negative cells and cytoplasm
Tissue shows retraction/crush artifact with discohesive clefts, limiting cellular detail
describe_en: EBER in situ hybridization shows nuclear signal in a large proportion of the neoplastic cells against a red counterstain. The positive signal is confined to nuclei; negative cells show only counterstain. Tissue retraction and crush artifact limit assessment of cytologic detail. Diffuse EBER positivity in a CD20-negative, MUM1-positive large cell neoplasm supports EBV-positive plasmablastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloma with plasmablastic morphology is almost always EBER negative, so strong diffuse EBER favors plasmablastic lymphoma.
Also EBER positive but expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks the plasmacytic immunophenotype.
PEL is frequently EBER positive but is defined by HHV8 (LANA) nuclear positivity, which is absent in plasmablastic lymphoma.
Also diffusely EBER positive but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD56 with cytotoxic markers rather than MUM1/CD138.
